details:
After communitcating with the some world builders, i am not the only one with this issue. and they have reached the same conclusion

Due to a Recent update of VRC some worlds will crash questies due to run out of memory, this wasnt the case before and this effects both NEW and OLD worlds, Regardless of SDK 2 or SDK3

When a certain amount of people join  (12+) Questies will run out of memory and crash, this will cause them to rejoin, and when that happens, more questies crash, 

This isnt because Avatars as this was Tested using the same avatars and New ones, 

this isnt caused by world creators, because new and old ones that have and havent been touched, since said update are effected

Safety settings Do not fix this issue, in short

This can only be explained by a Recent update by VRC thats causing Quest users to Run out of Memory when the instance gets Populated. with around 12+ people. and needs to be fixed
